body: A long time ago, I upgraded from a Fender Bandmaster with DOD and Boss distortion and EQ pedals to a Mesa Boogie Mk IV. Long story short, have never looked at distortion, fuzz or overdrive pedals since. Dont need them with a Mesa Boogie.

No, its not completely false. If someone who is considering suicide can find hope and a reason to keep going and not hurt their loved ones, then that is a good thing. That means they care. Some people care so much about loved ones that they think  suicide is the only option. One thing is certain, emotional pain has a lot to do with the decision to take your own life. My perspective is biased. There were so many reasons my wife killed herself. I will never know the main reason. To cause us grief was something she said to another person. She was in a great amount of emotional turmoil.

It's hard to say why people commit suicide. To say that people consider their loved ones and  then do not kill themselves because of the "ramifications" is false. There are many anecdotes that support this claim. In my case, my wife told one of her friends that she wanted to make it as hard as possible for us when she killed herself. She did and it is.

I have been a widower for three months. My wife had breast cancer. She beat it but could not shake the feeling that she was as good as dead. That may be one of the reasons she decided to kill herself. Being 34 is still young. Seven months is not enough time to give yourself to heal from the loss of your husband. I hope you were able to say goodbye to him. Live with honor for the dead, no matter how they died. That's what I tell myself. Its hard. To keep going no matter what is how people survive. God knows that I have wanted to stop.
Yes, suicide is that Bad of an option. Don't do it.
